facts.statement: SOE donated $10 to the American Red Cross Haiti relief fund for every Zando (Haiti Relief item) purchased in Free Realms between January 15 and January 18, 2010, with a maximum donation of $25,000.
facts.quote: donating $10 for every EQ Plush Bear, EQ II Protectors of the Faydark Crate, and FR Zando sold

article_summaries.title: SOE Raises $25,000 for Haiti Relief
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer press-release repost describing SOE's January 2010 charity drive for Haiti relief. Free Realms players helped by buying the Zando spiked T-Rex pet, which SOE matched with a $10 donation per sale during January 15-18, 2010, capped at $25,000 total. The article gives the sale window, price and cap for this one promotion.
